evals.prompt: Let's start working on ticket #4521. It's a User Story to add OAuth2 login support to the API.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads spec-driven-config.md, checks .spec-driven-progress/ for existing context, creates a design doc with phases 1-4, and stops to await explicit user approval before proceeding to implementation.
assertions: Agent reads spec-driven-config.md before doing anything else
Agent produces a design doc covering what, why, and acceptance criteria
Agent explicitly stops and asks for approval before writing any code

evals.prompt: work on #7832 — it's a bug where the dashboard crashes when there are no items
evals.expected_output: Agent loads config and existing context, creates a concise bug-fix plan (root cause, fix approach, test plan), and halts for approval before touching code.
assertions: Plan identifies root cause and proposed fix
Agent does not write or modify code before user approval

evals.prompt: I need to refactor the payment module to reduce duplication. No ticket yet.
evals.expected_output: Agent should NOT use this skill — there is no associated ADO work item. Agent should either ask the user to create a work item first, or proceed with a simple code edit without invoking spec-driven-development.
assertions: Agent does not produce a full spec-driven planning document
Agent does not ask for ADO config values
If agent offers to help, it notes the lack of a work item

evals.prompt: We approved the plan for #4521. Go ahead and implement it.
evals.expected_output: Agent moves into Phase 5 implementation: creates a feature branch following the naming convention in config, implements changes with approval checkpoints before each commit and push.
assertions: Agent creates a branch following the convention in spec-driven-config.md
Agent pauses and asks for explicit approval before each git commit
Agent pauses and asks for explicit approval before each git push
Implementation stays within the scope approved in the plan
